content: The road to a true friend's house is never long, though the trail be steep and snowbound.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
sourceWork: Görva er gata til góðs vinar (Hávamál, Stanza 34) — Poetic Edda
explanation: When you visit someone out of stiff social obligation, five miles feels like an agonizing slog across razor rocks. But when journeying toward a soul whose presence is pure love, truth, and warmth, even thirty miles through howling blizzards feels like a walk through spring clover.
practicalInsight: Reach out across the distance to an old, true friend today. Make the effort to connect.
reflectionPrompt: Have you let the busyness of life create a false distance between you and a cherished, faithful friend?
